purpose: Preserve PDF page provenance while applying the already-validated sentence-level AI-Core rule engine and aggregate page decisions into one filing-level state without weakening positive-evidence requirements.

filing_aggregation.ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE: At least one page contains the already-frozen positive conjunction. Positive evidence is never canceled by weaker exclusion-only language elsewhere in the filing.
filing_aggregation.BLOCKED_AMBIGUOUS: No positive conjunction exists, but both adopter-only and R&D-only direct-AI evidence states occur in the filing; do not force one exclusion interpretation.
filing_aggregation.EXCLUDED_AI_ADOPTER_ONLY: No positive conjunction or R&D-only evidence; at least one adopter-only page exists.
filing_aggregation.EXCLUDED_AI_RND_ONLY: No positive conjunction or adopter-only evidence; at least one R&D-only page exists.
filing_aggregation.NOT_ESTABLISHED: No page establishes positive or explicit exclusion evidence.
